## 1. Technical Evaluation Criteria
Not specified in RFP.

## 2. Financial Evaluation Criteria

### Total Bid Price
- **What is assessed:** Total Bid Price calculated on Attachment D - Bid Price Form for providing all 16 required PingOne Advanced Identity Cloud subscription items, support care packages, training, onboarding, pre-paid professional services, and sandbox environments.
- **Weight / Points:** Not specified in RFP.
- **Evaluation method:** Lowest price method (the contract shall be awarded to the responsible Bidder submitting a responsive Bid with the most favorable Total Bid Price, defined as the lowest price on IFB Attachment D - Bid Form).
- **Pricing evidence required:** Completed, signed, and dated Attachment D - Bid Price Form with fully loaded unit prices and extended total prices for all line items (1 through 16).
- **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 14 • SECTION 5 — BASIS FOR AWARD

## 3. Mandatory Requirements (Pass / Fail)

### Reseller Authorization Letter
- **Requirement:** Bidder must submit a letter of authorization from the manufacturer (PingIdentity) providing evidence of the rights to resell all products and services required by this IFB.
- **Consequence if unmet:** Bids will be deemed non-responsive if no minimum qualification documentation is submitted.
- **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 10 • SECTION 3 – BIDDER MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS

### Acceptance of State IFB and Contract Terms and Conditions
- **Requirement:** Bidder must accept all State IFB and Contract terms and conditions, including Attachment A - Contract, as acknowledged in the Transmittal Letter.
- **Consequence if unmet:** Bids will be deemed non-responsive if the Bidder does not accept the State's terms and conditions.
- **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 12 • Section 4.2.1

### Submission of Attachment D - Bid Price Form
- **Requirement:** Bidder must complete and submit Attachment D - Bid Price Form in accordance with the Bid Pricing Instructions, filling in all blanks without amending, altering, or including contingent language.
- **Consequence if unmet:** Failure to adhere to instructions may result in the Bid being determined to be non-responsive and rejected by MHBE.
- **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 12 • Section 4.2.3

### Submission of Attachment B - Bid/Proposal Affidavit
- **Requirement:** Bidder must submit one (1) completed copy of Attachment B - Bid/Proposal Affidavit with original signatures alongside the bid submission.
- **Consequence if unmet:** False certification constitutes grounds for the State to reject the Bid/Proposal; failure to submit required attachments may result in the bid being treated as non-responsive.
- **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 12 • Section 4.2.4

### Submission of Attachment E - Federal Funds Attachment (including E-1 and E-2)
- **Requirement:** Bidder must complete and submit Attachment E, including Attachment E-1 (Certification Against Lobbying) and Attachment E-2 (Disclosure of Lobbying Activities, marking "NA" if not applicable).
- **Consequence if unmet:** May be treated as non-responsive / Not specified in RFP.
- **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 12 • Section 4.2.4

### Electronic Submission via eMMA Prior to Closing Date and Time
- **Requirement:** Bids and required attachments must be submitted electronically in PDF format via eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA) prior to 11:00 AM EST on July 16, 2026.
- **Consequence if unmet:** Bids received after the due date and time will not be considered (except as provided in COMAR 21.05.02.10).
- **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 11 • Section 4.1.2 & Section 4.1.6

- **Requirement:** A brief Transmittal Letter signed by an authorized individual must accompany the bid, containing all required corporate identification, contact information, eMMA number, FEIN/SSN, addenda acknowledgements, and explicit acceptance of State terms.
- **Consequence if unmet:** May be treated as non-responsive / Not specified in RFP.
- **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 11 • Section 4.2.1

### Submissions Required Upon Notice of Recommendation for Contract Award

## 4. Minimum Thresholds & Conditions
- **Threshold / Condition:** Authorized Reseller Status (must submit a letter of authorization from PingIdentity proving reseller rights for all required products/services).
  **Applies to:** All Bidders.
  **Consequence:** Bid will be deemed non-responsive if proof is missing.
  **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 10 • SECTION 3 – BIDDER MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS
- **Threshold / Condition:** Determination of Bidder Responsibility and Bid Responsiveness.
  **Applies to:** All Bidders.
  **Consequence:** Award is strictly conditioned on being determined responsible and submitting a responsive bid with the lowest Total Bid Price.
  **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 14 • SECTION 5 — BASIS FOR AWARD
- **Threshold / Condition:** Bid Irrevocability Period (bids must remain irrevocable for 120 days following bid closing date).
  **Applies to:** All Bidders.

- **Threshold / Condition:** Registration on eMaryland Marketplace Advantage (eMMA).
  **Applies to:** All Bidders.
  **Consequence:** Non-registered bidders cannot submit electronic bids through eMMA; paper and facsimile submissions are rejected.

### Submission of Paper Bids
- **Trigger:** Submitting a paper bid submission instead of electronic submission through eMMA.
- **Outcome:** Paper bids shall not be considered.
- **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 11 • Section 4.1.4

- **Trigger:** Transmitting a bid via facsimile.
- **Outcome:** Bids delivered by facsimile shall not be considered.
- **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 11 • Section 4.1.5

### Late Bid Submission
- **Trigger:** Submission of bid files after the deadline of 11:00 AM EST on July 16, 2026.
- **Outcome:** Bids received after the due date will not be considered (except as provided in COMAR 21.05.02.10).
- **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 11 • Section 4.1.6

- **Trigger:** Failure to explicitly accept all State IFB and Contract terms and conditions in the Transmittal Letter submission.
- **Outcome:** Bid will be deemed non-responsive.
- **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 12 • Section 4.2.1

- **Trigger:** Failure to submit the manufacturer authorization letter proving reseller rights with the bid.
- **Outcome:** Bid will be deemed non-responsive.
- **Source:** 364_rfp_PingOne_Advanced_Identity_Subscription_IFB_BPM057272_FINAL.pdf • Page 12 • Section 4.2.2
